protocol: After the original model comparison. Source selected by six or more completed unrepeated top-to-top cycles and permission for local use. A single reviewer marked the interval from each low handle position to the next overhead position from source video sampled at 4 Hz, before any inference on this source. Training references start with cycle four. Match once per cycle with the existing 0.35 s return margin; no human adjudication or ground-truth joint angles.
